propositions: The three whole-project readers (get_parent_map, get_comment_map, get_issuelinks_map) paginate via opaque nextPageToken cursor but have no test exercising more than one page, leaving a regression vector for silent truncation.
The cursor loop terminates on either isLast=true OR absent/null nextPageToken, but no test verifies both conditions independently or asserts that cursor values advance across requests.
A repeated (non-advancing) cursor token causes unbounded re-requests on live servers; the fail-open exception handler converts this spin into a silently partial map with no user-visible error.

A comprehensive test suite with three seeded-item page sets (250 items across 3 pages, and 40-item server cap variant) was added to verify recovery, cursor advance, dual termination conditions, and token-repeat hang behavior.

An AST structural guard was added to prevent future whole-project readers from skipping the pagination loop, with mutation verification that the guard catches unpaginated POST calls to /rest/api/3/search/jql.
